Sales Order Stages

Sales Order Stages helps businesses manage their sales workflow more effectively by introducing customizable stages for sales orders. With this app, you can track progress, streamline approvals, and gain better visibility into your order lifecycle. It’s designed to make your sales process more structured, transparent, and efficient.



Video Tutorial

  • Service

Features

Custom Sales Order Stages :

Create your own stages for sales orders. Match them to workflow of your company. Keep the process simple and organized.

Stage Tracking & Visibility :

Easily monitor the status of each order with clear stage indicators, ensuring no order gets stuck. See exactly where each order stands. Quickly spot delays or bottlenecks. Stay on top of your sales pipeline.

Workflow Automation :

Move orders between stages automatically. Save time by reducing manual updates. Speed up approvals and order handling.

Drag-and-Drop Interface :

Change order stages with a simple drag. No complicated steps or menus needed. Manage orders like tasks on a board.
